specialist.title: Moving focus never scrolls the focused element into view (Tab, backend `focus`, AT Focus)

specialist.title: The full accessibility tree is rebuilt on every repaint tick (CSS animation frames, caret blink, smooth scroll) even when no assistive technology is active

Track a semantic epoch in `Document`, bumped by DOM, attribute, value, selection, focus, layout-geometry and scroll changes but not by caret blink or paint-only animation ticks. specialist.classification_text: Confirmed defect (reproduced with the real headless host).

Result: `ui4me-host error: application failed (reason=Backend exited with exit status: 0)`, exit 1, with no hint about the cause. A user module (`.psm1`) is worse: the backend would be `-File X

specialist.title: Ctrl+C makes `pwsh -File app.ps1` exit 0, not the documented 130

specialist.title: SVG filter primitives run uncapped on the main thread (CPU/time DoS)
specialist.affected: resvg filter rasterisation (`resvg::filter::turbulence`, `feMorphology`, `feConvolveMatrix`, chained primitives) via `svg::raster_cache::SvgRasterCache::raster` -> `ResourceManager::paint_image`, called from the renderer paint path (`pipeline/resources.rs::lookup_at`) **on the main/GUI thread** (SVG raster happens at paint time, not on the asset worker).
